description: Browser API collecting every named field of a form. `get`, `getAll`, and `Object.fromEntries(formData)`.
A function passed to `<form action>`. React calls it with the `FormData` inside a transition and resets the form afterwards.
`useActionState(action, initialState)` returns `[state, formAction, isPending]`; the action receives `(previousState, formData)`.
Hook from `react-dom` that lets a child of a form read its `pending` state, for reusable submit buttons.
With Server Functions, forms submit natively before JavaScript loads and upgrade once it does.
Initial value of an uncontrolled input; also the value restored when the form resets.
